title: x509af: Add an expert info for cert validity
description:
Add an expert info if the frame arrival time is outside the
interval indicated in certificate. (Also handle the edge case
if the certificate validity interval is just bad because
notBefore is after notAfter.)

Fix #20848 (other than handling GeneralizedTime for year 2050
compliance.)

notes.body: Maybe the idea was to have a generated field indicating the certificate to be valid yes or no, e.g., `x509af.signedCertificate.valid` with value Yes / No / Unknown (prehaps not the latter), rather than an expert item. @tom.cordemans ?
Sure, we can add a generated field (also? I think an expert item is useful here). I'm not sure exactly what the reaction icons mean.
